message: Well, if you can find rue seed, holy basil, and bishop weed in Moscow, I'll definitely be impressed -- here in New England, availability concerns make the spice substitutions a practical necessity. As far as proportions go, I imagine you'll likely have to experiment and find out what works best for you -- comparing the recipes I see, the proportions mostly seem to be somewhere around 2 parts fenugreek, 6 parts salt, 20 parts ground dry red chillies, and 1 part each for the rest of the spices. The red onions go into the actual stew, not into the berbere. Let us know how it comes out!
